about.titleEnd: oo u Dhexeeya Waxbarashada iyo Fursadda
about.intro: FursadHub waxay isku xidhaa ardayda, ururrada iyo jaamacadaha iyadoo adeegsanaysa habab tababar oo dhab ah oo taageera waxbarashada iyo horumarinta shaqada.

mission.title: Himiladeenna
mission.body: Ku xidh ardayda fursado dhab ah, ururrada hibo soo koraysa, jaamacadahana natiijooyin tababar oo cad.

vision.title: Aragtideenna
vision.body: Bulsho tababar oo la isku halayn karo halkaas oo waxbarashada iyo waayo-aragnimada shaqadu wada shaqeeyaan.

reasons.students: Ardaydu waxay u baahan yihiin fursado tababar oo khuseeya.
reasons.organizations: Ururradu waxay u baahan yihiin hibo cusub oo karti leh.
reasons.universities: Jaamacaduhu waxay u baahan yihiin kormeer tababar oo habaysan.
reasons.platform: FursadHub waxay hababkan ku xidhaa hal madal.

organizations.title: Hel Ururro
organizations.subtitle: Baadh ururrada hadda bixiya fursado tababar oo guud.
organizations.empty: Ma jiraan ururro la mid ah raadintaada.
organizations.scopeNote: Tusaha waxa ku jira ururrada ka muuqda tababarrada guud ee hadda la daabacay.

universities.title: Horumari Maamulka Tababarka
universities.subtitle: Sii jaamacaddaada habaysan ay ardayda ku taageerto laga bilaabo magacaabista ilaa dhammaystirka tababarka.
universities.directoryNote: API-ga madashu hadda ma bixiyo tusaha jaamacadaha ee guud.

students.title: Maamulka Ardayda
students.body: Maamul ardayda diiwaangashan iyo xubinnimada waaxyaha.

nominations.title: Magacaabista Ardayda
nominations.body: U magacaab ardayda u qalanta fursadaha jaamacadaha loo beegsaday.

placements.title: La Socodka Meel-dhigista
placements.body: La soco meel-dhigista laga bilaabo aqbalidda ilaa dhammaystirka.

supervision.title: Kormeerka Tacliinta
supervision.body: U qoondee kormeerayaal oo dib u eeg horumarka tababarka.

verification.title: Hay'ad La Xaqiijiyay
verification.body: Ku dhis kalsooni habka xaqiijinta madasha.

hero.description: FursadHub waxay ardayda ku xidhaa fursadaha tababarka, ururradana xirfadlayaal da'yar oo karti leh, jaamacadahana waayo-aragnimo shaqo oo dhab ah.

internships.title: Tababarro guud
internships.body: Raadi fursadaha dhab ahaan la daabacay

ecosystem.title: Sida FursadHub u Shaqayso
ecosystem.subtitle: Hal madal oo loogu talagalay ardayda, ururrada iyo jaamacadaha

student.title: Ardayda
student.body: Hel tababarrada la daabacay, mari hababka codsiga ee la taageero, lana soco tababarkaaga ilaa dhammaystirka.

organization.title: Ururrada
organization.body: Daabac fursado, dib u eeg musharraxiinta, oo maamul waajibaadka tababarka goobta shaqada.

university.title: Jaamacadaha
university.body: Taageer magacaabista ardayda oo kormeer shuruudaha tacliimeed iyo hagidda tababarka.

landing.subhead: FursadHub waxay isku xirtaa ardayda, jaamacadaha iyo ururrada hal habka tababarka — laga bilaabo codsiga ugu horreeya ilaa difaaca ugu dambeeya.

student.title: Ardayda
student.body: Hel oo u codso tababaro la xaqiijiyay oo ay bixiyaan ururro iyo jaamacado ku yaal Soomaaliya.

organization.title: Ururrada
organization.body: Ka helia oo ka shaqaaleysii ardayda jaamacadaha la xaqiijiyay, kadibna maamul meel dhigidda oo dhan.

university.title: Jaamacadaha
university.body: La socod tababarka ardaydaada laga bilaabo magacaabidda ilaa difaacooda ugu dambeeya.

sourcing.title: Dir ama hel
sourcing.body: Ururradu waxay daabacaan fursado; ardayduna si toos ah ayey ugu codsadaan ama waxaa magacaabo jaamacaddoodu.

recruitment.title: La is xir
recruitment.body: Codsiyada guud iyo magacaabista jaamacadaha waxay isku biiraan hal socod musharrax oo geeya ilaa dalab shaqo.

placement.title: Meel dhigidda ilaa dhammaystirka
placement.body: Diiwaanka usbuucyada, imaanshaha, kormeerka iyo qiimeynta ayaa tababarka geeya ilaa difaaciisa.

landing.trustLine: Loogu talagalay jaamacadaha, ururrada iyo ardayda Soomaaliya.

lifecycle.title: Hal socod, laga bilaabo ilaa dhammaystirka
lifecycle.body: Meel dhigiddu kuma dhamaato dalabka shaqada oo keliya. FursadHub wuxuu socodsiiyaa diiwaanka usbuucyada, imaanshaha, kormeerka labada dhinac, qiimeynta iyo difaaca ugu dambeeya — si jaamacadaha iyo ururradu u arkaan horumar dhab ah.

cta.title: Ma diyaar u tahay inaad bilowdo?
cta.body: Diiwaan-gelintu waa bilaash intii lagu jiro tijaabada — samee akoon adigoo arday, urur, ama jaamacad ah.

footer.description: Hal habka tababarka ee ardayda, jaamacadaha iyo ururrada Soomaaliya — laga bilaabo codsiga ugu horreeya ilaa difaaca ugu dambeeya.
